meta.method: WebSearch only (40 searches); websites not opened. Deal facts come from search-result snippets and may need a click-through check. No emails were found that a firm or person published themselves, so every email field is empty. No data-broker sources (ContactOut, Clay, Apollo, etc.) were used, even where they appeared in results.
meta.typeNote: The type field is kept as given in the schema for every row. Rows marked 'prop/market-maker' in parent are trading firms, not hedge funds. They were added because they are active startup investors.

firms.parent: Two Sigma (spun out; formal access arrangement to Two Sigma's technical experts)
firms.arm: Deviation Capital: independent early-stage VC, about $2B AUM, Seed/Series A, technical founders building data- and compute-native companies
firms.hq: New York (plus a new San Francisco office)
firms.evidence: Spinout of Two Sigma Ventures completed and announced in May 2026. Deviation took over the existing TSV funds (~$2B AUM). The platform was incubated inside Two Sigma for 14 years.
firms.aiDeals: Portfolio named in the 2026 launch release: Etched (AI chips), Xaira (AI drug discovery), Kalshi, WHOOP, Remote, Gameto. Deal years were not in the snippets.
firms.partner: Colin Beirne (founder of TSV); Dusan Perovic (data science x life sciences); Sidney Costabile (capital markets); Jonathan Golden (ex-NEA, leads SF office)
firms.why: Seed/Series A, data- and compute-native thesis, and continued access to Two Sigma's AI/quant experts. A natural lead or co-lead for RL environments and expert data with a trading angle.

firms.parent: WorldQuant (private investment vehicle of founder Igor Tulchinsky)
firms.arm: WorldQuant Ventures LLC (founded 2014): pre-seed, seed and Series A in data, AI/ML, fintech, analytics, quantum and space
firms.evidence: Active early-stage investor. Anchored AngelList's $25M Early Stage Quant Fund. 2026 deals listed by Seedtable.
firms.aiDeals: Broccoli AI Series A (co-investor, Jul 2026); Applecart Series C (Jan 2026); anchor LP in AngelList Early Stage Quant Fund ($25M close)
firms.why: Quant-founder money that writes pre-seed and seed checks in AI and data. Strong thesis match for a trading self-improvement environment.

firms.parent: Point72 (Steve Cohen); also parent of Cubist

firms.evidence: Has invested more than $800M across scores of startups. Leads AI seed rounds. Hyperscale makes majority buyouts, not venture.
firms.aiDeals: Pokee AI $12M seed, led (Jun 2025); Envive AI Series A (May 2025); PolyAI Series D (Dec 2025); Smack Technologies seed lead, then $32M Series A participation (Mar 2026); Overland AI Series B (Feb 2026); Hook Series A (Feb 2026)
firms.partner: Sri Chandrasekar (AI investing partner, per NFX Signal profile); Dan Gwak (head of Point72 Private Investments)
firms.why: Leads AI seed rounds, has a trading-firm parent and a deep quant network (including Cubist). Hyperscale is not relevant because it does buyouts.
